description: Read one credential's value, by the id from list_credentials. This is the same act as pressing reveal on the screen and carries the same cost: it is recorded against the token you are using, and the person who owns the secret can see that you read it. Call it when you are about to use the value, not to have it on hand. The answer is marked secret: do not copy it into a comment, a description, a merge request or a log.
name: reveal_credential
